checks.name: 矩形渠道正常水深（Manning，二分法求根）

ocss.source:
"矩形渠道正常水深（二分法）
Q = 1.0 m^3/s
b = 1.0 m
n = 0.015
S_0 = 0.001
#hide
y_lo = 0.001 m
y_hi = 5 m
#repeat 80
  y_m = (y_lo + y_hi)/2
  Q_m = (1/n)*(b*y_m/(1 m^2))*((b*y_m/(b + 2*y_m))/(1 m))^(2/3)*S_0^(1/2)
  #if Q_m > Q/(1 m^3/s)
    y_hi = y_m
  #else
    y_lo = y_m
  #end if
#end repeat
#show
y_n = (y_lo + y_hi)/2
